Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished standalone landscape social launch poster, 1536x1024 composition. Clean warm-white / very pale ivory background, lots of negative space, sophisticated violet #8B5CF6 and near-black palette matching VCam. Crisp large editorial typography, extremely readable at feed size. A polished mixture of premium 3D product illustration and clever internet humor, not a generic template. This is a conceptual promotional illustration, not a screenshot. Write only the exact quoted copy in the brief. No watermark, no invented star counts, no fake awards, no fake metrics, no QR code, no tiny paragraphs, no dark background. VCam is a free MIT-licensed Windows app that turns an iPhone or Android into a webcam using the phone browser over local Wi-Fi. Windows receiver required, video only. Do not depict USB transport or a native mobile VCam app. The brand symbol is a folded translucent violet glass ribbon forming a V.
Concept: flagship launch artwork. A giant elegant translucent violet folded V sculptural symbol behind a floating generic smartphone and a slim generic Windows laptop, both showing the same beautiful simple lavender flower video scene. Phone screen has a minimal browser top bar. Fine violet wireless arcs connect them. Physical studio lighting, soft contact shadows, beautiful material detail. Asymmetrical airy editorial layout with hero headline at upper left, product render dominating lower-right. Exact copy: small 'Introducing VCam'; huge 'Your phone.\nYour webcam.'; footer 'FREE & OPEN SOURCE' and 'Windows · iPhone · Android'. Make this feel like an exciting beautifully designed indie app launch.
